name: Frame Window Counter
description: Auto-places practice checkpoints before each click and shows how many ticks (frames) your click has to work. Experimental.

lookback.name: Checkpoint lookback (ticks)
lookback.description: How many ticks before your click the checkpoint is taken. The test covers this many ticks either side of your click.

after-release.name: Survive after release (ticks)
after-release.description: How long after your click a test run must survive to count as a pass.
